name: Baseline
description: Use the illustrative base capacities, travel times, and uniform release.
primary_change: Base illustrative demand, capacity, and travel assumptions
assumption_note: Metrics are deterministic results from synthetic demand and capacity assumptions; not observed operations.

name: Rail disruption
description: Halve capacity on all rail edges in both directions for the whole run.
assumption_note: Metrics are deterministic results from synthetic demand and capacity assumptions; not observed operations.

name: Increased rail capacity
description: Increase capacity on all rail edges by 50%; no new route is implied.
assumption_note: Metrics are deterministic results from synthetic demand and capacity assumptions; not observed operations.

name: Bad weather
description: Illustrative rain reduces walk/rail capacity by 20% and increases travel times by 25%.
assumption_note: Metrics are deterministic results from synthetic demand and capacity assumptions; not observed operations.

name: Staggered departure
description: Double the post-match release window without adding passengers; commercial dwell is assumed, not measured.
assumption_note: Metrics are deterministic results from synthetic demand and capacity assumptions; not observed operations.
